thread:
maya: Kicking off vendor/netops onramp scope for private deploys — short sync. Goal: define the minimal packaging + handoff for customers that manage their own networking. P1: preserve customer IPs, predictable egress, upgrade rollback lanes. Need launch gates and owner asks by EOW.
own: Quick Q — are we targeting single-tenant (dedicated) only or also multi-tenant operator bundles?
sophie: We should split: (1) single-tenant VPC onramp, (2) shared-operator with shim. Different install presets + docs.
maya: Agree. MVP = single-tenant VPC first (most enterprise asks). Operator shim is P2 but must have upgrade compatibility.
jordy: Proposed launch gates (draft): 1) Installer can set static egress IPs and preserve existing customer prefixes. 2) Canary path with BGP passthrough or NAT relay validated. 3) Rollback test that reverts operator bundle within 15m without tenant traffic loss. Thoughts?
lee: Add: telemetry & KMS checks — offline installs must surface whether telemetry is on, and KMS/HSM integration must be validated (manual key import flow).
maya: Good call. Add to launch gates: KMS import flow tested, cert rotation validated.
own: On the network side, need clarity on egress pinning semantics. Does pinning mean we require static IP blocks per-tenant or per-cluster? We should outline cost tradeoffs.
sophie: Recommend per-cluster static egress for MVP (simpler). Per-tenant can be opt-in later. Document the tradeoff: per-tenant = more NAT resources, per-cluster = fewer customer changes.
maya: Noted. I'll capture in the spec.
jordy: For upgrade/rollback choreography, propose this flow snippet for operator upgrades:
```
0) create canary namespace with traffic mirror
1) deploy operator vX+1 to canary nodes
2) run smoke tests (BGP session, egress IP match, KV cache warm)
3) if OK, rollout incrementally; if fail, rollback operator to vX and revert iptables changes
```
lee: Add explicit smoke for "egress IP stability" — validate source IP for a small set of test endpoints pre/post-upgrade.
net-bot: CI: netpack-integration branch: e2e-network-smoke failing on bgp-session.test (timeout). See: https://ci.internal/reports/3421 :eyes:
sophie: Thanks @net-bot. That failing test blocks gate #2. Assigning to @owen to triage BGP timeouts.
own: On it. Preliminary: stack shows BGP hold timer mismatch with vendor router; will add config patch.
maya: Back to scope: we need a concise installer preset list in the spec that ops can hand to customers. Draft preset names: `minimal-vpc`, `preserve-egress`, `airgap-lite`. Each preset enumerates network expectations + customer tasks.
jordy: Can we add a tiny JSON example to include in the handoff? Something like:
```json
{
  "preset": "preserve-egress",
  "required_customer_steps": ["announce-prefix", "allow-icmp-probes", "provide-bgp-asn"],
  "optional": ["enable-operator-shim"]
}
```
sophie: Perfect — that'll help field teams. Also include sample runbook: contact points, test commands (curl --interface), and expected response codes.
lee: Security note: for airgap-lite, ensure the installer includes an offline artifact manifest and signature verification step. Compliance teams will require that.
maya: OK. Action items: (a) @owen triage CI bgp timeout, (b) @sophie draft installer presets + handoff JSON, (c) @jordy write upgrade/rollback checklist and canary smoke tests, (d) @lee list telemetry/KMS gating tests. We'll reconvene Thursday. Please add any missing owners. :thumbsup:
own: Adding a follow-up PR for bgp fix, ETA tomorrow EOD.
sophie: I'll drop initial presets doc in product drive and tag this thread.
jordy: I'll stub the rollback playbook and include commands for reverting iptables and operator manifests.
lee: I'll enumerate KMS integration test steps and share with security.
maya: Thanks — last ask: what counts as GO/NO-GO for early customers? My suggestion: GO if all gates pass in two distinct customer environments and rollback validated once. NO-GO if any gate fails or if rollback not validated. Agree?
own: Agree. Two envs + one rollback success = GO.
sophie: Agree. Also require operator monitoring dashboards to show stable token-level cost + latency baselines before GA.
maya: Noted. Wrapping — I'll update the spec doc and ping reviewers. If anyone wants to add to the handoff JSON, do so in the drive doc.
net-bot: Reminder: scheduled network test sweep tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Results will be posted in #eng-runtime.
maya: Great, thanks everyone.
